description: Create printable 5×5 bingo cards with classic B-I-N-G-O number ranges, an optional free space, or your own custom word list.

faqs.a: Yes — the classic ranges are used: B 1–15, I 16–30, N 31–45, G 46–60, O 61–75, with no repeats on a card.
faqs.q: Does it use standard bingo number ranges?

faqs.a: Leave the free-space box ticked for the classic center star, or untick it for a full 25-cell card.
faqs.q: Can I include a free space?

faqs.a: Choose the custom-words mode and paste up to 24 words — they are shuffled into the grid.
faqs.q: Can I make bingo cards with words instead of numbers?

faqs.a: Press New card as many times as you like, then use the Print button for a clean print layout.
faqs.q: How do I print multiple cards?
